intent: Create a new visual direction only when no authoritative Design Contract exists (create or explore modes).
steps: Confirm design_mode is create or explore and no authoritative mockup covers the Work Unit
Ground the design in the approved brief without inventing users or goals
Derive distinctive choices and a compact token system
Search the design system inventory before creating components
Build to the plan within explicit free zones
Document rationale and mark inferences that need human validation
invariants: Must not be used as the primary procedure under conform or adapt
If an authoritative design appears, stop and request a human decision
